chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 387: “The White Tower” – Li Huowang Fights a Monster and a Mind Trap
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang is swallowed whole by a sea monster, only to wake strapped to a bed in White Tower Hospital—but this is no rescue. A visceral, disorienting chapter of survival and a new layer of Heart-Turbid horror.
og_title: Swallowed, Then Strapped to a Bed: Chapter 387’s Raw Horror
og_description: The transition from water monkeys to a padded cell is seamless and sickening. Li Huowang breaks his own hand to escape.
twitter_title: From Sea Monster to Straitjacket: Chapter 387
twitter_description: Li Huowang is eaten alive, then wakes in White Tower. He breaks his own bones to escape a trap that might not be real.

lore_anchors.definition: A psychiatric prison in the modern-world hallucination; also a digestive illusion inside the sea creature, serving as a Two-Layer Heart-Turbid containment.
Folk-horror water entities that drown and eat victims; in this novel, they are a hair-covered, monkey-faced swarm with no supernatural agenda beyond hunger.
A powerful military-pattern sword that corrupts normal wielders but can be used by a Heart-Element constitution without losing control.
